title: Milwaukee with Charlie Elgar and Omer Simeon
summary: After Oliver he went to Milwaukee with Charlie Elgar's band, where Omer Simeon, a fine clarinetist who never got his due, helped him and he blossomed.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: And I worked with Omer Simeon, and he's a fine clarinetist, too. Here's a boy that he really deserves a lot of praise but never did receive it, and he helped me a lot.
He showed me a lot of it that I had forgotten. And by working with him, and he was a real fine man.
Did he play the same system that you did?
And we got together, and then I really blossomed out. I began to blossom out real good. Then I stayed in Milwaukee all that year.
